Based on the screenshots provided:

**1) Hero Section:**
*   **Butterfly 3D Art:** Yes, there is a stylized, 3D-looking butterfly graphic on the right side of the hero section.
*   **Readable Text:** The text is highly readable. It uses a clear serif font for the "PAPILIO" heading and a clean sans-serif font for the description, with good contrast against the background.
*   **Defects:** There are no obvious visual defects or layout errors. The design is clean and professional.

**2) Footer Section:**
*   **Watermark:** **Yes**, there is a very faint, large butterfly watermark visible in the bottom right corner of the dark footer area. It serves as a subtle branding element.
*   **Layout:** The layout looks **clean** and well-organized. It uses a standard 4-column grid (Brand Info, Find Us, Explore, Order & Plan) with clear headings and legible text.
